tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline threats to Antarctica from fishing and whaling.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar Antarctic content; either threat earns full marks.

units.summary: Analyse a line graph, proportional circles and map showing changing Antarctic ice and sea-level contribution.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of three linked quantitative figures; no own knowledge needed.

units.summary: Using a photograph of a container ship and own knowledge, assess transport as a factor in globalisation.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short assess applying knowledge to a single novel photograph.

units.summary: Assess impacts of world trade in a chosen commodity or product on the student and people globally.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring chosen trade example, multi-scale impacts and sustained evaluation.

units.summary: Explain the difference between experienced places and media places.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 explanation of two defined categories of place; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse the changes in Newton Abbot shown by a 1946 map and a 2019 satellite image.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 comparison of two geospatial sources of different type and date.

units.summary: Using a Lowry painting and own knowledge, examine endogenous factors shaping a place's character.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 application of a named concept to an unfamiliar artwork.

units.summary: Assess whether place meaning simply reflects socio-economic characteristics and whether external rebranding can change it.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay linking meaning, identity, socio-economic change and agency rebranding; evaluative extent judgement.

units.summary: Explain why thunderstorms are common in urban areas.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 explanation of a specific urban climate process; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse changes in water quality and biodiversity brought about by a river restoration project.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of qualitative project information and quantitative monitoring data.

units.summary: Evaluate the success of one British urban policy since 1979 in contributing to urban resurgence.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark evaluate item (AO1 4 AO2 5) needing a named policy and judgement of outcomes.

units.summary: Assess the effects of incineration and landfill waste disposal on the carbon cycle.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item with synoptic link to the physical carbon cycle and comparison of two methods.

units.summary: Assess how far new urban landscapes have intensified economic inequality and social segregation.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay needing several landscape types and evaluation of their social effects.

units.summary: Outline the Malthusian perspective on population growth.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a named theory; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse relationships between ecological footprint, HDI and Happy Planet Index for selected countries.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of three linked indices in a multi-variable chart.

units.summary: With two climatic types, assess the extent to which precipitation influences human activities.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item requiring two studied climate types and comparison of precipitation against other controls.

units.summary: Evaluate the extent to which global governance is needed to secure food supply.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item with synoptic link to global governance from Section A.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of human and physical factors in global patterns of health and morbidity.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay spanning communicable and non-communicable disease and two factor groups.

units.summary: Outline the difference between indicated and inferred resources.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of defined stock-resource terms; comparison needed.

units.summary: Assess the extent to which the role of one specified ore in global commerce creates sustainability issues.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item needing one specified ore and evaluation of extraction, trade and processing issues.

units.summary: Assess the extent to which carbon cycle changes can lead to water stress.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item with synoptic link between the physical carbon cycle and water security.

units.summary: Assess whether transnational corporations prioritise profit over environmental impact in energy production and distribution.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring an energy example, TNC role and evaluative judgement with a synoptic globalisation link.
